metric_definitions.ranked-mode-requested-calls: Count actual model response tool calls named search whose parsed arguments explicitly set mode=ranked, including subsequently rejected arguments.
metric_definitions.ranked-mode-successful-calls: Count executed ranked search tool results with ok=true and valid closed ranked_read metadata, including empty outputs.
metric_definitions.ranked-windows-returned: Sum exact observations.length across successful ranked outputs; no delivery credit implied.
metric_definitions.receipt-confirmed-ranked-observations: Count distinct native read_id values bound to actual ranked search calls in successful model request receipts; do not count archive-only, tokenizer-only or failed dispatches.
metric_definitions.exported-union-span-recall: Existing native trajectory final-step span coverage over all confirmed exported observations, after exact projection/export reconstruction; keep unmapped changed-line count separately.
metric_definitions.useful-coverage-per-10000-model-tokens: For valid scored task i with complete positive total model tokens T_i and union recall C_i, Q_i=10000*C_i/T_i. C is fraction0..1, not percentage; T includes all model input/output and finalization.
metric_definitions.ranked-mode-empty-output-calls: Successful ranked tool calls with zero returned observations.
metric_definitions.navigation-only-model-responses: Count discovery model responses having at least one tool call and every call named list_files or rank_sources. Mixed batches and edits/search/read responses do not qualify.

aggregate_rule: Arithmetic mean of Q_i over all four fixed tasks, equal task weights; no pooling numerator/denominator and no used-task-only subset. Show each task delta too.

adjudication.eligible: All four fixed tasks valid with exact native reconstruction, complete known positive model tokens, verified windows, and all mechanism counters reconstructed; otherwise mechanism comparison is inconclusive and campaign completion/quality gates may fail independently.
adjudication.zero_use: If no receipt-confirmed ranked observations across all four tasks, direct-read mechanism is inconclusive. Report zero-use tasks explicitly; retain every task and cost in the fixed cohort. Do not claim direct-read benefit on zero-use tasks.
adjudication.supporting: When eligible and some ranked observations are confirmed, candidate fixed-cohort mean Q exceeds baseline mean Q by more than1e-12 AND mean native span-F1 is at least baseline minus1e-12. This is descriptive candidate-level support only, not causal attribution to ranked reads.
adjudication.counterevidence: When eligible with some confirmed ranked observations, failure of either supporting comparison is counterevidence for the prospective candidate benefit. Report per-task regressions, mode exposure and precision separately.
adjudication.invalid_cost: T<=0, noninteger or unknown model usage yields Q=null, never0 or infinity. Missing/invalid output or missing counters yields Q=null for adjudication. No failed task is dropped; four-task mechanism comparison becomes inconclusive. Known lower bounds and conservative spend remain reported.
adjudication.campaign: Perfect native quality on every task and all existing campaign gates remain unchanged. Mechanism support does not finish the goal. Original15%token reduction, causality and untouched confirmation remain unproven.
